name: free-jt7-agent
description: Auto-provisions Free JT7 agent instructions in any opened workspace.

commands.title: Free JT7: Provision Agent In Workspace
Free JT7: Start OpenClaw Gateway Now

freeJt7Agent.autoProvision.description: When true, create Free JT7 instruction files automatically on workspace open.

freeJt7Agent.overwriteExistingFiles.description: When true, overwrite existing AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md.

freeJt7Agent.createCopilotInstructions.description: When true, create .github/copilot-instructions.md in each workspace.

freeJt7Agent.createTraceabilityFile.description: When true, create .github/free-jt7-trace.md to keep persistent task traceability.

freeJt7Agent.agentFileName.description: Name of the agent instruction file to create at workspace root.

freeJt7Agent.syncVsCodeSettings.description: Sync Free JT7 VS Code settings to the active workspace path.

freeJt7Agent.settingsTarget.description: Where to write Free JT7 settings updates. Workspace is recommended for any-project behavior.

freeJt7Agent.enableSkillCreatorAgent.description: When true, provision .github/agents/skill-creator.agent.md and skill-creator skill files.

freeJt7Agent.openClawAutoStart.description: Try to start OpenClaw gateway automatically after provisioning.

freeJt7Agent.openClawProjectPath.description: Path to the project that contains skills_manager.py for OpenClaw gateway commands.

freeJt7Agent.openClawStatusCommand.description: Command used to query OpenClaw gateway status.

freeJt7Agent.openClawStartCommand.description: Command used to start OpenClaw gateway.

freeJt7Agent.openClawCommandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for OpenClaw status/start commands.

freeJt7Agent.openClawAutoDetectWorkspace.description: If true, search skills_manager.py in the opened workspace when openClawProjectPath is empty.
